lines.en: Hello, Doctor. My eyes feel tired today.
I see. When did your eyes feel tired?
Last week, after I read a long book.
Do your ears hurt too?
No, my ears are fine. Only my eyes.
Turn your head and look at my hand.
I see your hand and your face.
Good. Your eyes are healthy. Just rest them.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 눈은 건강해요. 그냥 쉬게 해 주세요.

lines.en: Will my eyes feel better soon?
Yes. Rest tonight, and they will feel better.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 밤 쉬면 좋아질 거예요.

lines.en: Grandma, let's play. What is this?
That's your nose. Now touch your mouth.
lines.ko: 그건 코예요. 이제 입을 만져 보세요.

lines.en: Here is my mouth! Where are my ears?
Your ears are on your head. Good job!
Yesterday I learned arm and leg at school.
Great. Can you move your arm and your leg?
Yes, I can. Look at my hands too!
lines.ko: 네, 할 수 있어요. 제 손도 봐요!

lines.en: You know your whole body now. I'm proud.
Will we play again tomorrow, Grandma?
Yes, we will. Thank you for playing with me.
lines.ko: 네, 그럴 거예요. 같이 놀아 줘서 고마워요.
